method.decision: Consider fresh confirmation if a supplement adds two useful results across two generator families with at most one new ordinary source group per panel and no new room-only flag. Same-word resynthesis is a processing control for localized spoken-content change and has a separate count.
method.geometry: Use the unchanged two four-second model contexts, 0 and 2 s, and original waveform preprocessing and activity. Use median frame responses in one-second windows every half second, with the lower median where both contexts cover a window.
method.normalization: Compare native per-context moments with shared scale only and shared center and scale. Pool raw Mel frames with centers before 3 s from the first context and at or after 3 s from the second. Estimate per-band center from the pooled values. Estimate shared within-context variance from the pooled values after centering each retained split at its own mean, with denominator n-2. Only the affine normalization changes, and original context waveform conditioning is retained.
method.selection: For each arm set a strict point at the larger of the highest eligible isolated background score and the second-highest new ordinary group maximum. Keep prior serving flags for the supplement comparison. Declare useful at 50% edit coverage and 0.30 temporal IoU.
method.source: Use previously scored native six-second clips and their frozen labels. Choose the point on the 44 severe stock mixtures. Hold out the random-clock and three-generator panels, plus the SINE original/variant pairs for splicing and same-word resynthesis under competing speech, and eight room-only controls.
